drug_class: Serotonin antagonist and reuptake inhibitor (SARI); Antidepressant

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer; may reduce trazodone levels and increase serotonin syndrome risk due to combined serotonergic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout period if switching

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonergic activity; additive serotonin effects may precipitate serotonin syndrome

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic activity; increased risk of serotonin syndrome with combined SARI mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult clinician if considering supplementation

caution_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
caution_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; may have additive serotonergic effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild stimulant properties; may increase CNS effects or reduce sedative benefit
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive stimulation or altered sedation; dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depression and sedation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive drowsiness; generally safe at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly delays trazodone absorption and increases bioavailability; may alter efficacy timing
avoid_foods.action: Take on empty stomach or consistent with/without food; avoid taking immediately after high-fat meal

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; potentiates sedation and impairs cognition
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol; if used, limit to moderate amounts and monitor for excessive drowsiness

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase trazodone plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Monitor for increased side effects; consider avoiding or using consistently if therapeutic benefit affected

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome, particularly with concurrent serotonergic agents (SSRIs, MAOIs, tramadol). Assess for excessive CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension, especially in elderly patients or those on concurrent CNS depressants.
